connector.name: Mailkite
connector.registryDescription: Send email, manage domains, DNS, webhooks, templates, and inbound routing on MailKite
connector.summary: Hosted at mcp.mailkite.dev over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the npm package mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace dev.mailkite, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: MAILKITE_API_KEY
env.description: MailKite API key (mk_live_…) from the dashboard at https://app.mailkite.dev
